notes.primary.asp_configs: The operational identity is assay + diagnosis + environment, with retained document versions. query_policy_release, clinical_rule_release and clinical_rule_base are historical capture fields: current schema comments and writes explicitly exclude them from new runtime captures. Preserve historical data without making these fields a prerequisite for new configurations.
notes.primary.blacklist: pos matches variants.simple_id, not variants._id. The repository queries and indexes (assay,pos); assay stores the biological group identifier. Coverage exclusions use d4_coverage_blacklist instead.
notes.primary.annotation: No SAMPLE_ID, sample_oid or variant_oid foreign key exists here. Nomenclature p/c/g uses protein/cDNA/genomic identity; cn uses variant; f/t use ordered gene1/gene2 plus variant. Preserve namespace, assay scope, author, timestamps and class versus text. VEP 103 is a migration-specific source requirement, not a universal runtime version.
notes.primary.anno_vep: Shared transcript vault in PRIMARY, not the knowledgebase database. Unique index: (simple_id_hash, vep_version). Not owned by one sample; never delete it just because one sample is removed.
notes.primary.samples: case_id, control_id, case.id and control.id describe sample material/case-control identifiers; they are not self-references to samples._id. The primary samples collection and BAM-service samples collection are different namespaces.
notes.primary.clinical_rule_sets: rule_set_id is the stable rule identity, content_version the clinical release, revision the save counter, and _id one content-version document. None are interchangeable. The published document is immutable; reference dependencies are resolution by full scope, not merely matching the display name.
notes.primary.query_rule_sets: scope_key/query_id identify a policy scope; version and revision are distinct. Application-provided base conditions live in software, not in a hidden MongoDB base-query collection. Authored rules add to those base conditions.
notes.primary.public_assay_catalog: published_offerings and resource_revisions are retained publication projections. They do not turn every public read into a live lookup of the newest assay or gene list.
notes.primary.assay_setups: Draft content can precede operational resources. Keep original _id, revision and content_editors, created_by/at and updated_by/at. Editing leases live in edit_leases, not in this collection. Published setup revisions are retained.
notes.knowledgebase.onkokb: Physical binding oncokb_collection → onkokb is intentional in the current mapping. This collection has repository-defined Gene/Alteration records, without a COLLECTION_MODEL_ADAPTERS entry. Do not silently rename it to oncokb during migration.
notes.knowledgebase.oncokb_public: query_hash is the cache identity for a normalized public API query, not variants.simple_id_hash. Retain query, response, reference_genome and data_version. Public API evidence is not equivalent to the licensed actionable dataset.
notes.knowledgebase.hpaexpr: tid is a transcript accession. The rna_expression document is sample-owned; HPA rows are shared external reference values, not owned by that sample.
notes.primary.ingest_jobs: source_payload contains the accepted submission, and result is a workflow receipt. SAMPLE_ID references belong to the resulting clinical documents, not an inferred job._id foreign key. Reconcile in-flight jobs and staging directories before replaying an import.
notes.primary.edit_leases: Resource identity is encoded in _id as length-prefixed resource kind + canonical identifier. Owner + editor_id controls renewal/release. It is operational, 90-second state: do not migrate live leases as clinical history.
notes.identity.audit_events: Retained traceability records and hash chains are not editable migration bookkeeping. resource.type/resource.id are polymorphic historical provenance; the referenced clinical object can have been deleted. Do not enforce a universal foreign-key constraint on these fields.
notes.identity.operational_audit_events: Operational retention differs from permanent traceability history. These events do not participate in the traceability hash chain.
notes.primary.app_controls: Singleton _id=default. Module/task/retention settings are software configuration keys, not references to one collection per setting.
notes.bam.samples: External BAM-service database. Its id is the case/control material identifier and bam_path is a filesystem resource. No primary samples._id equality is implied.
